customManagers.description: Home Assistant add-on base images declared in build.yaml build_from (Dockerfiles use FROM ${BUILD_FROM}, so the native dockerfile manager can't see them)

packageRules.description: home-assistant/builder must stay on a version tag. It builds its image reference from its own ref -- `input=$(echo ${{ github.action_path }} | rev | cut -d/ -f1 | rev)` then `docker pull ghcr.io/home-assistant/<arch>-builder:${input}` -- so a digest pin resolves to ...-builder:<sha>, which is not a published tag, and every build fails with 'manifest unknown'. The chodeus-ops preset sets pinDigests:true for all github-actions; this rule follows it and wins.
